svg.title: Figure 11.1 Many χ² distributions
svg.desc: Chi-square density curves for 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10 degrees of freedom on a horizontal axis from 0 to 15. With 1 or 2 degrees of freedom the curve is highest at 0 and decreases; with more degrees of freedom it rises to a peak and has a long right tail, and the peak moves right and flattens as df grows.
